title: pilosella bauhini subsp. thaumasioides
intro: Pilosella bauhini subsp. thaumasioides, commonly known as a type of dandelion, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its ability to treat digestive issues and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella bauhini subsp. thaumasioides include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as arthritis and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
